hero.text002: Because Humanity Deserves to See Its Own Light.
hero.text003: Discover Humanity. Preserve Its Story. Let Its Echo Travel.
hero.text004: Every day, people create moments of compassion, courage, protection, solidarity, creativity and hope. Echoes exists to discover the human acts we should not allow the world to forget.
section01.text009: An Echo does not require fame, wealth or a grand gesture. It can begin with one decision, one act of care, one courageous voice, one useful idea or a community choosing not to leave someone behind.
section01.text011: Human beings choosing to care when another person needs kindness, presence or understanding.
section01.text013: People who act with humanity when doing so requires strength, integrity or personal resolve.
section01.text015: Actions that defend children, vulnerable people, communities or human dignity from harm.
section01.text017: People standing beside one another and turning belonging into practical support.
section01.text019: Art, invention and imagination used to connect, heal, illuminate or create human possibility.
section01.text021: People sharing learning, discovery or expertise in ways that strengthen others.
section01.text023: Acts that build understanding, reconciliation and human connection across division.
section01.text025: People solving problems together and creating value that no individual could create alone.
section01.text027: Stories that remind us that difficult circumstances do not have the final word.
section01.text029: Quiet acts that may never become headlines but still change another person's day, dignity or life.
section01.text030: You do not have to change the world to become an Echo. Sometimes changing one person's day is enough to remind us who we are.
section02.text031: FROM A HUMAN ACT TO HUMANITY'S MEMORY
section02.text032: An Echo Is Discovered, Not Manufactured
section02.text033: Recognition begins with a real human act and grows only when the story can be understood responsibly.
section02.text035: A person, group, community, idea or creative act carries human value worth noticing.
section02.text037: A citizen, community, contributor or Echoes team member brings the story forward.
section02.text039: Facts, context, consent, dignity and relevant safety concerns are considered before recognition.
section02.text041: The person behind the moment is given context and voice rather than reduced to a headline.
section02.text043: A story may be brought forward for special recognition without ranking one person's humanity above another's.
section02.text045: An annual honour can preserve stories whose meaning deserves to travel farther through time.
section02.text047: The story remains discoverable as part of a growing memory of human dignity, courage, care and possibility.
section02.text049: Echoes should not depend on a central office deciding where humanity exists. People around the world can help discover it.
section02.text050: Nominate → Review → Verify → Consent & Safety → Publish
section02.text052: Bring forward someone whose action or continuing work carries a human story worth preserving.
section02.text054: Share a collective act of solidarity, protection, creativity or care.
section02.text056: Tell us about a moment of everyday humanity even when you are unsure who should receive recognition.
section03.text057: ONE SYSTEM · FOUR EXPERIENCES · ONE MEMORY
section03.text059: Discovery, storytelling and recognition have different purposes. Together they allow meaningful human stories to travel without turning humanity into a contest.
section03.text061: Find human acts, people, communities and ideas that deserve to become visible.
section03.text064: Go beyond the moment and understand the human being, context and meaning behind an Echo.
section03.text067: Bring a story forward so more people can encounter it, without declaring a winner.
section03.text070: Give lasting annual visibility to human stories whose resonance deserves a place in collective memory.
section03.text073: Echoes does not measure whose compassion is greater, whose suffering matters more or whose goodness deserves the highest score. Recognition simply says: this happened, this mattered and humanity should remember it.
section03.text074: An Echo is not a winner. An Echo is a human story we choose not to let disappear.
section03.text076: As Echoes grows, recognized stories should form a searchable human memory across years, places and themes. The archive is not a hall of fame. It is a record of moments when people showed what humanity can be.
section03.text078: Return to the people and context behind recognized human acts.
section03.text080: Explore stories given special visibility through monthly recognition.
section03.text082: Preserve annual honours as part of a growing record rather than a winners list.
section03.text084: Allow verified stories to live through interviews, documentaries, audio and other responsible media formats.
section03.text086: Media → Discovery → Echo → Story → Recognition → Archive → Media
section03.text087: A story can enter through Media, a citizen or the community; become an Echo; deepen through Stories; receive recognition; enter humanity's memory; and travel again through the global media network.
cta.text089: Know a Story We Should Not Let Disappear?
cta.text090: Bring forward a person, community, idea or everyday human act that deserves to be seen, understood and remembered.
